# `scripts/post-process/range_http_server.py`

Source: [range_http_server.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/range_http_server.py)

Minimal read-only HTTP server with Range requests (what DuckDB httpfs, pyarrow/fsspec need to read Parquet column
chunks remotely), logging one JSON line per request (path, range, bytes sent, ms) for byte and request counts.

usage: range\_http\_server.py &lt;root dir&gt; &lt;port&gt; &lt;log file&gt;        (test only: no TLS, no auth, read-only)

## Contents

- [`class H`](#class-h) - HTTP/1.1 file server for `ROOT` with Range support and a JSON log of every request (bytes, time).
- [`class S`](#class-s) - Threaded HTTP server (daemon threads, address reuse).

## class H

```python
class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler)
```

HTTP/1.1 file server for `ROOT` with Range support and a JSON log of every request (bytes, time).

### H.log_message

```python
log_message(self, *a)
```

Silence the default request log (the JSON log replaces it).

### H._path

```python
_path(self)
```

The requested file under `ROOT` (query string ignored), or None if outside ROOT or missing.

### H._log

```python
_log(self, rng, n, t0)
```

Append one JSON line (time, method, path, range, bytes, ms, client) to `LOG`.

### H.do_HEAD

```python
do_HEAD(self)
```

Answer with the file size (or 404).

### H.do_GET

```python
do_GET(self)
```

Send the file or the requested byte range (206), or 404 / 416.

## class S

```python
class S(socketserver.ThreadingMixIn, http.server.HTTPServer)
```

Threaded HTTP server (daemon threads, address reuse).
